summary: This is a routine quarterly earnings release furnished under Item 2.02, together with a preferred stock dividend declaration under Item 8.01. Green Brick Partners reported Q1 2026 EPS of $1.39, net income of $60.9M, 908 deliveries, 1,037 net orders, and a 28.9% gross margin. The company also announced a quarterly dividend on its 5.75% Series A Preferred Stock of $359.38 per share ($0.35938 per depositary share) payable June 15, 2026 to holders of record June 1, 2026. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, spin-off, or restructuring is present. The share repurchases noted are routine, not part of a formal capital return program exceeding normal-course. Accordingly, this filing is classified as None.
